lyrics:
[Intro: droning sitar riff alone, then galloping tom-toms]

[Verse 1: sneering, low, driving beat]
Draw the curtains on the garden, put a cloth across the glass
Unplug the coloured lights and let the summer pass
Somebody's laughing on the street outside my door
I can't be doing with the brightness any more

[Chorus: sitar doubles the voice, bass pounding]
Dim it, dim it, dim the whole world down
Turn the sun to embers, turn the sky to brown
I'll come back to colour when the colour's mine
Till then, dim the whole world down

[Verse 2: sneering, more urgent]
The telephone keeps lighting like a window in the night
Every little picture is too happy and too bright
I walk among the neighbours and I nod and look away
There's nothing in the world I've got to say

[Chorus: sitar doubles the voice, bass pounding]
Dim it, dim it, dim the whole world down
Turn the sun to embers, turn the sky to brown
I'll come back to colour when the colour's mine
Till then, dim the whole world down

[Bridge: drums drop to a heartbeat, voice close]
Nobody said the light would hurt
Nobody said

[Final Chorus: full band, organ, voice shouting]
Dim it, dim it, dim the whole world down
Turn the sun to embers, turn the sky to brown
I'll come back to colour when the colour's mine
Till then, dim the whole world down

[Outro: humming over the sitar riff, drums gallop, fade]
Hmm, hmm-hmm, hmm
Hmm, hmm-hmm, hmm
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 159 BPM, 4/4, E minor with an Eastern, modal flavour. A relentless gallop. Dark, hypnotic and driven.

VOICE: Male, nasal and sneering, half sung and half snarled, with a London edge. He stays low in the verses and shouts the last chorus. The outro is hummed on the riff with his mouth closed.

INSTRUMENTS: A sitar playing a droning, winding riff that doubles the vocal melody. Galloping tom-tom drums with almost no cymbals. A pounding bass, with the low notes doubled on organ pedals. Acoustic guitar strumming hard. Organ in the last chorus. Castanets.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the sitar alone, then the drums. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Chorus 1. 0:54 Verse 2. 1:18 Chorus 2. 1:36 Bridge, the drums drop to a heartbeat. 1:50 Final chorus. 2:10 Outro, humming over the riff as the drums gallop, fading by 2:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1960s British rock: raw, dense and slightly distorted, mostly in the middle of the stereo field, drums and sitar loud.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The sitar riff alone in the first five seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The second verse puts the unbearable brightness on a phone full of happy pictures. One new line ('I'll come back to colour when the colour's mine') is what people learn about grief after living through it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Withdrawal, anger, a promise to return.
